events.summary: 当前关联候选oixCloud：2026-10-12站方称收到游戏加速无法联网或联机异常反馈，数日排查后归因为部分高位端口重定向可能改变源IP或使UDP转发不稳；将优化转发策略。拟优化不等于已恢复。
events.quote:
📢 游戏加速连接异常及后续优化说明

近期，我们陆续收到多位用户反馈，在游戏加速场景下（如 PS4／PS5 等设备）出现无法正常联网或联机异常的问题，经过数日持续排查，目前已成功定位问题原因

此前，为降低 SPAM 滥用投诉风险，我们将部分高位端口的流量重定向至其他具备较强抗投诉能力的服务商，但这一调整可能导致部分连接的源 IP 发生变化，或出现 UDP 转发不稳定的情况，进而影响游戏联机及加速体验

为改善这一问题，我们将进一步加强服务端对 BT（BitTorrent）下载流量的识别与阻断能力，减少滥用流量对正常业务的影响，并优化相关端口的流量转发策略

虽然相关调整可能增加 BT 下载流量绕过限制的风险，但我们预计能够有效改善部分特殊端口的连接稳定性，提升游戏加速及其他 UDP 应用场景下的使用体验

感谢各位用户一直以来的理解与耐心，我们将持续优化网络环境与服务质量

——

📢 Gaming Connectivity Issues & Upcoming Improvements

Recently, we’ve received reports from several users experiencing connectivity issues when using our services for gaming, particularly on devices such as PS4 and PS5. After several days of investigation, we have successfully identified the root cause.

Previously, to reduce the risk of SPAM and abuse complaints, we redirected traffic on certain high-numbered ports through alternative providers with greater tolerance for abuse-related complaints. However, this adjustment could cause source IP changes or unstable UDP forwarding for some connections, affecting online gaming and acceleration performance.

To address this issue, we will further strengthen our server-side BT (BitTorrent) traffic detection and blocking capabilities, reducing the impact of abusive traffic on legitimate usage while optimizing traffic forwarding policies for affected ports.

Although these adjustments may increase the risk of BT traffic bypassing existing restrictions, we expect them to significantly improve connection stability on certain ports and enhance the experience for gaming acceleration and other UDP-based applications.

We sincerely appreciate your continued understanding and patience as we continue to optimize our network infrastructure and overall service quality.
